description: Rust: port ranges in config parsing, with a new error variant and its use in main. Unrequested: ports above 65535 are clamped instead of rejected.

intent.goal: Accept port ranges like 8000-8010 in the configuration.
requirements: A port can be given as a range like 8000-8010
An invalid port or range is rejected with a clear error

pullRequest.title: Port ranges
pullRequest.body: `port = "8000-8010"` now works; the server binds to the first free port in the range.

domainChanges: Ports can be configured as a range like 8000-8010
Ports above 65535 are clamped to 65535 instead of rejected
The server binds to the first free port in the range
